Unit 1: Helping Your Community[cite: 1]

Video Track 1.1, page 4, activities B and C[cite: 1]

These elephants live in Uttar Pradesh in India[cite: 1]. It gets cold in the winter[cite: 1]. The Elephant Conservation and Care Center helps the elephants[cite: 1]. The women in the village make sweaters for the elephants[cite: 1]. The sweaters use about nine pounds of wool[cite: 1]. Seven women make one sweater[cite: 1]. It takes two to three weeks to make each sweater[cite: 1].

The sweaters keep the elephants warm[cite: 1]. They cover their legs, back, and neck[cite: 1]. Some elephants like the sweaters, but some don’t like the sweaters at all[cite: 1].

“Maya gets very ticklish wearing a sweater, so when we tried putting the sweater on her, she absolutely refused to wear it, she actually tried to throw it off[cite: 1]. So then, if she doesn’t like it, obviously we would not force it on her[cite: 1]. She loves it so she wears it[cite: 1].”

Elephants are very intelligent[cite: 1]. They are easy to teach[cite: 1]. Some people capture the elephants[cite: 1]. Sometimes they hurt the elephants[cite: 1]. The conservation center helps the hurt elephants[cite: 1]. There are 21 elephants at the center now[cite: 1].

Elephants like to play and take baths[cite: 1]. But they don’t wear their sweaters then[cite: 1]!
